sloka: तस्मिन्निपतिते बाणे वागभूत्तत्र मानुषी ।कथम् अस्मद् विधे शस्त्रम् निपतेत् तु तपस्विनि ॥२-६३-२८॥
transliteration: tasminnipatite bāṇe vāgabhūttatra mānuṣī ।katham asmad vidhe śastram nipatet tu tapasvini ॥2-63-28॥

translations.english: When the arrow hit him, a man's voice was heard saying, 'How can an arrow be discharged at a person like me who is an ascetic?'
